Then the Lord said to Abram: go from your country, your family, and your father's house.
Go to the land I will show you. I will make you a great nation, and bless you.
In you, all the families of the earth will be blessed.
Abram was seventy-five. He set out with Sarai his wife and Lot his nephew.
In Canaan, at Shechem, the Lord appeared: to your descendants I will give this land.
He pitched his tent near Bethel and called on the Lord's name.
Then a famine came, and Abram went down to Egypt.
Afraid, Abram asked Sarai to say she was his sister. She was taken to Pharaoh's palace.
But the Lord struck Pharaoh's household with great plagues.
Pharaoh sent Abram away, with his wife and all that he had.
God asked Abram to leave everything familiar, without showing him the whole road.
He went, not knowing where he was going.
Faith is not seeing the whole path. It is taking the next step.
And God blesses others through that step.
What step is God asking you to take today?
